410312.name: Code Reaction Enhancement
410312.description: While active, damage dealt to targets who have an Elemental Advantage is increased. This applies both to this unit and to Nikkes.

410313.name: Laser
410313.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

410314.name: Machine Gun
410314.description: Fires a barrage of machine gun bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

410315.name: High-Power Laser
410315.description: Fires a high-power laser, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes. Any Nikkes who are hit will suffer sustained damage.

410316.name: Spherical Bomb
410316.description: Launches bombs, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The bombs can be intercepted.

410317.name: Special Bullet: Stun
410317.description: Fires special bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.
